raw_site_text: Table 1 residence regions: Kampala (UG), Central (UG), Eastern (UG), Northern (UG), Western (UG); "Uganda's four different regions plus the capital city Kampala"
justification: Ugandan S4C participants were interviewed by phone and reside across Kampala and the Central, Eastern, Northern and Western regions, which map to the four WB survey-region groups.
note: Mapping of Uganda's four statistical regions to WB groups by geographic knowledge; sample is former S4C program participants (region of residence rather than a single field site). District-level composition not reported.
